# Dranima

> Dranima is an upcoming indie monster-tamer RPG inspired by classic late-1990s
> and early-2000s JRPGs. Players explore the original world of Conwind, collect
> and bond with ("drame") 200 unique creatures called Dranimae, and build teams
> of up to 8 for strategic turn-based battles. Developed by Dranima Studio in
> Godot. Currently in prototype phase; release date TBA; planned for PC via Steam.

## Key facts

- Genre: monster-tamer / creature-collector JRPG, turn-based combat
- Creatures: 200 unique Dranimae across 18 elemental types (rarest: Rainbow)
- Party: up to 8 Dranimae, 4 active in battle; actions are Act, Switch, Drame, Run
- Signature mechanic: Dranimae Synergy (type-matched party leader boosts allies)
- Platform: PC (Steam planned); languages: English, French, Portuguese, Spanish
- Studio: Dranima Studio, founded by Alex C. Bourbon; independent, self-funded
- Engine: Godot 4.4.1; status: prototype (battle system ~50% implemented)
